findings.summary: Any authenticated user can read any invoice, regardless of ownership or permissions.
findings.evidence: canReadInvoice returns true solely when user.authenticated and invoice are truthy; it never compares tenant, owner, role, or access grants.

findings.summary: The document listing function returns documents without tenant filtering.
findings.evidence: listDocuments ignores user entirely and returns the complete documents collection.

findings.summary: A successful reservation is left active when the subsequent charge fails.
findings.evidence: processOrder calls gateway.reserve before gateway.charge but has no compensation, cancellation, or recovery handling for charge failure.

findings.summary: Older status events can overwrite newer order state.
findings.evidence: applyStatus unconditionally assigns event.status and event.sequence without rejecting an event whose sequence is not newer than order.sequence.

findings.summary: Repeated delivery of the same payment message can produce duplicate charges.
findings.evidence: processPayment directly invokes provider.charge without an idempotency key, deduplication record, or processed-message check.

findings.summary: Per-user identifiers create an unbounded telemetry attribute dimension.
findings.evidence: requestAttributes emits request.userId as the "user.id" attribute for every request.

findings.summary: The project pins a Log4j version affected by the Log4Shell remote-code-execution vulnerability.
findings.evidence: pom.xml declares org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core:2.14.1, which is affected by CVE-2021-44228.

findings.summary: Nested retry loops invoke a failing operation up to nine times per logical call.
findings.evidence: The three-iteration outer loop contains a three-iteration inner loop, and every inner iteration calls operation().

findings.summary: The migration immediately drops a column, breaking callers that still read or write it and preventing simple rollback.
findings.evidence: migration.sql contains only ALTER TABLE accounts DROP COLUMN legacy_status, with no staged deprecation, compatibility period, or data-preserving recovery step.

limitations: Only the supplied fixture source was available; no tests, runtime behavior, schemas, deployment topology, or consumer contracts were provided.
The reference files linked from RIVET-GUIDANCE.md were absent, and Rivet executable evidence tools were unavailable as stated.
